_comment: Routes to remove from the deployment bundle entirely.
A static export cannot return a 404 status. A page that calls notFound()
still writes a file, so Apache serves it with 200 and a not-found body —
a soft 404, which search engines index and which reads to a crawler as a
real page. Deleting the file makes the 404 genuine.
Keep this in step with `flags` in lib/site.ts: switching a section back on
means removing it from here too, or the route will 404 despite being
enabled. Two places, deliberately — the alternative was guessing which
exported pages are not-found renders by their content, and there is no
marker in the output that reliably says so.
